This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **30** documentable anchor(s).

**15** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via SchemaRegistry (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx`  _(via ObjectQLPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/packages/:packageId (route, bridged from symbol installPackage — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`  _(via SchemaRegistry (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/frontend/architecture-overview.mdx`  _(via resolveObject (symbol, a method of class SchemaRegistry))_
- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/packages/:packageId (route, bridged from symbol installPackage — its route source's handler names it))_

- `content/docs/kernel/services.mdx`  _(via ObjectQLPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ObjectQLPlugin (symbol, a top-level class), /api/v1/packages/:packageId (route, bridged from symbol installPackage — its route source's handler names it))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **60** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 870ebce333bf0a5794307febe077ab5652cfbfe9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `77a0afd77bac2334ae6ff88f473dc6e1940544c3` — the merge of head `81f7ce8a12d8ddc8231c9a1f7c86b509fed46a2d` into base `870ebce333bf0a5794307febe077ab5652cfbfe9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 77a0afd77bac2334ae6ff88f473dc6e1940544c3 && git checkout 77a0afd77bac2334ae6ff88f473dc6e1940544c3
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 870ebce333bf0a5794307febe077ab5652cfbfe9 81f7ce8a12d8ddc8231c9a1f7c86b509fed46a2d && git checkout -B drift-repro 870ebce333bf0a5794307febe077ab5652cfbfe9 && git merge --no-ff 81f7ce8a12d8ddc8231c9a1f7c86b509fed46a2d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 870ebce333bf0a5794307febe077ab5652cfbfe9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 870ebce333bf0a5794307febe077ab5652cfbfe9` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `12d54cf316b406138a1110e9c5a04b0125567959`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/objectql/src/engine-compatibility-api.ts, packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts, packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts, packages/objectql/src/registry-disabled-package-extensions.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/registry.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-disable-module-extension-fields.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts + packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migration-plugins.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-rotation.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts, packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts, packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts (the published spec and the cited code, read to judge the narrowing, not reviewed; the changeset read for ② only)

Inputs: card #30304 (body, triage 6650917536, claim 6651772742, dev report 6652852213), PR #30362 (body, 8-file list, 3-dot diff against `main` at merge-base 8c9f48f8), the check-runs on the head. Read-only: the head was fetched into a review ref and read with `git show`; nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Each accept-set or public-surface change the diff implies, read in the head tree:

1. **Served folds withhold a disabled package's `extend` contributions** — `resolveObject` (behind `getObject` / `getAllObjects`), the per-package fold `resolveObjectLeavingExtensionsOut`, and `foldObjectExtendersOnto`, all through one predicate `withholdDisabledExtensions` over `isPackageDisabled` (the predicate objects, flows, nav and actions already use at L7920, L8005, L8584). **Right.** Fields, rules, indexes and field patches of the withheld contributor leave the fold because it is folded from `withheld.kept`; a field the owner or a kept extension also declares stays (`keptFields`). Pinned in the registry suite on all four readers, control + disable + re-enable.
2. **A base that already carries withheld members is stripped** (`withoutWithheldMembers`: a tenant overlay saved from a served read, a metadata-service copy seeded from a resolved body). **Right for fields and rules; incomplete for indexes** — see ④ should-fix 1.
3. **Cache** — `disablePackage` / `enablePackage` already call `invalidateAll()` (L8441, L8456); `installPackage` now invalidates when the row lands disabled (L8221, the boot-seed case the registry suite pins); `uninstallPackage` already does (L8408). `mergedObjectCache` is keyed by FQN in one registry per kernel and disable is per environment (`setPackageDisabled(environmentId, …)`), so no second copy stays stale. **Right.** The metadata-service copy is not a cache of the fold: `foldObjectExtendersOnto` strips and re-folds it per read, and `bridgeObjectsToMetadataService` seeds a served body that the enable re-folds (`subtractExtenderContributions` + fold). **Right.**
4. **New public surface** — `SchemaRegistry.getStorageObject(name)` / `getAllStorageObjects()` (the full fold; by identity `resolveObject`'s answer when nothing is disabled, pinned `toBe`), and the optional `LifecycleEngineLike.registry.getAllStorageObjects?` member. A widening beside the narrowing; both named in the PR body and changeset. **Right.**
5. **Storage readers moved to the full fold** — `ObjectQLPlugin.readRegisteredObjects(seam, 'storage')` for `syncRegisteredSchemas`, `registerSchemasWithoutDdl` and `reconcileFederatedBindings` (the governance inventory keeps the served read); `ObjectQL.syncSchemas` / `syncObjectSchema`; the lifecycle sweep's `declared` list, so `cold.syncSchema(object, obj)` at L1419 mirrors every hot column. **Right as far as it goes — one storage reader was missed** (must-fix below), and the summary index is a second storage-shaped reader left on the served fold (should-fix 2).
6. **`readBaseContributions` field loop skips a disabled contributor** as its `nav` loop does; makes `package-lifecycle.zod.ts` L598/L605 ("A disabled package's contributions are not listed, as the fold drops them") true for fields. **Right.** The array-level describe (L603–605) still names flows and nav only — spec lane #30086, correctly not edited here.
7. **Data plane** — no code change: a write, filter, sort or `fields` naming a withheld field meets the served field map and answers the unknown-field refusal (`400 INVALID_FIELD` / `INVALID_SORT`), pinned byte-for-byte against an unknown name on create, update, filter, sort and fields; a write through other fields lands and leaves the stored value alone; re-enable serves 500 and the summary 2000 again. **Right**: the card's asks (`/meta/object`, `/data` reads and writes, re-enable with values) are met through the real doors.
8. **Code layer untouched** — `resolveOwnerLayer` → `getArtifactItem('object')` still folds every contributor (artifact identity for the save gates). **Right**: it answers "what does the code ship", not "what is served"; the layered read's `code` layer comes from the metadata-service copy and is measured without the withheld fields.
9. **A disabled package that OWNS the object** still folds whole to registry readers (pinned). **Right**: the data plane refuses the object itself by owner (`isObjectPackageDisabled`, `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`).

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/30304-disabled-package-extension-fields-withheld.md`: `@objectstack/objectql: minor`, `@objectstack/runtime: minor`; title carries `!`; `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` line-initial in the changeset body and the PR body, identical arms; `Metadata-protocol: semantic` on both; exactly one ADR-0087 marker, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. The "Who moves" paragraph is the migration text a breaking changeset owes (nothing an author can write is removed, so no FROM → TO mapping and no tombstone are due).
- Level: AGENTS.md §Post-Task Checklist 3 — a kind other than `none` takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves; the diff moves objectql and runtime. **Matches.** `semantic` is the right kind: no key is added or refused, the meaning of an `objectExtensions` declaration under package disable changes. `Check Changeset` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are green on the head.
- One mismatch outside the diff: the seat's claim 6651772742 on the card still reads `Metadata-protocol: none`; the dev declared `semantic` and the claim text said the seat would amend. Owed by the seat, not the PR (noted under ③).
- `Clause-②:` line: `yes (narrowing)` is the right arm — the new storage readers and the two registry methods are a widening beside the narrowing, so `no (narrowing)` would be false.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviation: PR opened without labels** — the order named none. Answered.
- **Deviation: lifecycle sweep moved beyond the In list** — read in `lifecycle-service.ts` L741–746 and L1419: with the served fold the archive datasource would be synced without the withheld column and the hot-row copy would fail. Right call; answered.
- **Open question 1 (a rule of another, enabled package reads a withheld field → every write to the object is `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` naming the rule while disabled)** — judged below in ④ (acceptable for this PR; ruling card owed).
- **Open question 2 (roll-up index built from the served fold; a withheld summary over a child in an enabled package is stale after re-enable until the next child write)** — should-fix 2 below.
- **Dogfood battery owed by the seat** — `Dogfood Regression Gate` reports `success` on the head (its matrix shards show `skipped`); the seat reads that as the gate's answer. The `!` and the narrowing arm are declared.
- **Follow-ups the dev names** (#30086 array-level describe, spec lane; ui residue for a layout naming a withheld field, ui lane paused) — acknowledged; neither is this diff's.
- **Claim line `Metadata-protocol: none` on the card** — the seat amends it to `semantic` (escalated to the seat; see ②).

### ④ Design judgment

**The narrowing itself, against the published spec on `main`.** No published schema declares that an `objectExtensions` field outlives its package's disable. `package-lifecycle.zod.ts` L598 and L605 already say a disabled package's contributions are not listed "as the fold drops them"; the error-code ledger (L699) defines `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` as "the data plane refuses rather than serving rows". The fold did not drop them, so the spec's own statement was false for fields. This PR makes the spec's withholding real at the consumer; it takes no declared capability away. `ObjectExtensionSchema` (object.zod.ts L4979) declares what an extension adds, not that it survives its package being switched off. The design holds; the card's ask is met through the real doors. The judgments below are about the implementation of the design, read in the live tree.

**Must-fix 1 — a DDL-free `os migrate` binds the served fold and then reports the disabled package's columns as orphans to drop.** `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migration-plugins.ts` L2406 (`measureComposedCoverage`) reads `engine.registry.getAllObjects()` — the served fold — and on the `ddlFree` branch (L2442, reached from `schema-migrate.ts` L1484 with `ddlFree: skipSchemaSync`, the `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1` posture) calls `driver.registerObjectMetadata([obj])` per object. `SqlDriver.registerManagedObjectMetadata` (sql-driver-rotation.ts L163–170) ALWAYS overwrites `managedObjectFields` and `managedObjectIndexes` for the table — so the boot's own `registerSchemasWithoutDdl` (now storage, right) is overwritten with a field map missing every withheld column. `detectManagedDrift` diffs the physical schema against that map (schema-drift.ts L1455–1474) and reports each of those columns as "column exists in the database but not in metadata (orphaned) — os migrate apply --allow-destructive to drop it", with a `drop_column` op. A tenant that disabled a module (HotCRM's exact shape) and runs the documented drift remedy on a DDL-free deployment is led, by a false plan, to drop the module's columns and values. This is the card's red line (no column drop or value loss) through a path this PR's own rule names ("storage readers move to the full fold") and missed. Fix: that pass reads `getAllStorageObjects?.() ?? getAllObjects()` like the other storage readers, with a pin that a disabled extension's column is not reported orphaned under `ddlFree`. Before this PR served and full folds were one answer, so the misreport is new to this head.

**Should-fix 1 — `foldObjectExtendersOnto` leaves a withheld extension's indexes on a folded base.** `withoutWithheldMembers` takes fields and rules off the base; `subtractExtenderContributions(contributors, served)` is run over `withheld.kept` only (registry.ts L5738–5740), so a metadata-service copy seeded while the package was enabled keeps serving the withheld extension's `indexes` entries (naming fields the object no longer serves) through the by-name read while disabled. The registry pin "a base that already carries the withheld members" checks fields and rules, not indexes. Subtract the withheld contributors' index entries from the base too (one line: run the subtraction over `listed`, or pass withheld index keys into `withoutWithheldMembers`), and extend the pin.

**Should-fix 2 — the roll-up index is a storage-shaped reader on the served fold.** `ObjectQL.buildSummaryIndex` (engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts L134) reads `getAllObjects()`; the index is memoised against `objectRevision`, which `invalidateAll` bumps, so enable/disable rebuilds it correctly — but while disabled a withheld `summary` whose child object belongs to an ENABLED package is not recomputed, and the stored column is stale after re-enable until the next child write. The card's own shape (child in the same disabled module, refused on the data plane) is unaffected and pinned (2000 back). Because the summary is a stored column, keeping it current is the storage layer's job: build the index from `getAllStorageObjects` where the child object is readable, or recompute withheld summaries on enable. A card for the lane; not blocking.

**Should-fix 3 — open question 1 (cross-package rule reading a withheld field).** Read in `rule-validator.ts` L4231–4238: a predicate over a field the record does not declare is a broken rule and is fail-closed since #4649; this PR adds no code there. The disable door (`packages.ts` L1922–1947) checks no dependents, so a module of another package can be switched off under a rule that reads it. Judgment: **acceptable for this PR.** The card's scenario is module → app; a module whose rule reads a field of a module it neither declares nor depends on is the authoring defect the fail-closed policy exists for, the consequence is loud (400 naming the rule, never a 5xx or a silent verdict flip), and the changeset's "Who moves" names it. It is not acceptable to leave undecided: a suite that ships cross-module rules (HotCRM phase 1 PSA/O2C may) needs a ruling — refuse the disable while an enabled package's rule or formula reads the field, skip such rules while disabled, or require the dependency at install. File the ruling card in the server lane with the measured pin as its evidence; the formula case (answers `null`, 200) needs no ruling.

**Tried and held.** (a) Column/value loss: boot sync, DDL-free registration, federated binding, `syncSchemas` / `syncObjectSchema` (the CLI's deferred, non-DDL-free branch goes through `syncObjectSchema`, so it is right), lifecycle sweep + archive schema mirror: all on the full fold; a boot that starts disabled creates the columns and an enable with no restart writes them (pinned). (b) Write/filter/sort/`fields` naming a withheld field: unknown-field parity pinned byte-for-byte on five doors; no new refusal code. (c) Caches: fold cache invalidated on enable, disable, install-disabled, uninstall; metadata-service copies are re-folded per read; a tenant overlay carrying the field is stripped while disabled and re-served on enable; per-environment disable, one registry per kernel. (d) Judged above.

**Gates.** The check-runs on `12d54cf316b406138a1110e9c5a04b0125567959`, read after the last one completed: 48 runs, 35 `success`, 13 `skipped` (the UI matrix and build/lint/typecheck UI legs, Build Docs, the opt-in tarball smoke and 18.x harness, the schedule gate, the dogfood matrix shards behind a green `Dogfood Regression Gate`), 0 `failure`. Green among them: Build Core, Test Core 1–8 and the aggregate, Type Check workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, Lint ESLint / repo & tooling / docs & code guards / CI-release-engine gates / PM dispatch-gates / the three scoped lints, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Live E2E UI. The gates derived from this diff pass; the FAIL above is ④'s must-fix, which no gate measures (the CLI drift plan under `ddlFree` with a disabled package has no pin).

Delta review of record 6653307077 (head `12d54cf3`), which this record supersedes for the new head. Inputs: card #30304 (body and every comment, the claim 6651772742 as amended at 2026-11-05T08:26Z), PR #30362 (body, 10-file list, the 3-dot diff against `main`, the delta `12d54cf3..f2ce2c0f`: commits 024ea96e and f2ce2c0f, 4 files, +96/−7; `12d54cf3` is an ancestor of the new head, no force push), the contract-review claim 6653662896 for this head, the check-runs on `f2ce2c0f`. Read-only: the head fetched into a review ref and read with `git show`; nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Judgments 1–9 of record 6653307077 stand on this head unchanged (the delta touches none of the served folds' predicate, the storage readers in objectql/runtime, the cache invalidation points or `readBaseContributions`). The delta implies two further accept-set changes:

10. **The DDL-free drift binding reads the storage fold** — `measureComposedCoverage` (`schema-migration-plugins.ts` L2406–2408) reads `getAllStorageObjects()` when the registry has it, falling back to `getAllObjects()` for an engine without it, so the `registerObjectMetadata([obj])` call on the `ddlFree` branch installs the full field set as the driver's `managedObjectFields` and the drift report no longer names a disabled package's columns as orphans. **Right**, and the exact fix M1 asked for. The pin reaches a real `SqlDriver` over file-backed SQLite: a table created with the module enabled holding `qm_credit: 500`, the module disabled (precondition: the served object withholds the field), `measureComposedCoverage(…, false, { ddlFree: true })` examines the object, `detectManagedDrift()` carries no op naming `qm_credit`, and the stored value reads back 500 — the red line (no column drop, no value loss) measured through the door that would have broken it. `syncObjectSchema` in the test double throws if reached, so the pin cannot pass by running DDL.
11. **A withheld extension's indexes leave a folded base** — `WithheldExtensions.withheldIndexes` is built from `indexKeysOf` over `stableStringify(index)`, the same structural key `subtractExtenderContributions` compares by, net of the owner's and kept extensions' index keys; `withoutWithheldMembers` drops matching entries from the base's `indexes` and still answers `base` by reference when nothing matches. **Right**, and the exact fix S1 asked for; the two pins (folded metadata-service body, tenant overlay saved from a served read) now assert the index is gone from the served body while the storage fold keeps the field. `foldObjectExtendersOnto`'s re-add path is unaffected: a kept extension's index is subtracted and re-added once, as before.
